title: The theory rests mostly on findings in rodents

statements.text: The observations the theory is built on come mainly from subcortically projecting layer 5 pyramidal neurons in rodents, and it was proposed to be tested directly in the rodent model where the compartments and the nonspecific thalamus can be manipulated.

sources.quote: primarily on subcortically projecting (extratelencephalic, ET) layer 5 (L5) pyramidal neurons in rodents
The present conjecture can be directly tested in the rodent model
